methodology: An opportunity opens when one transaction moves a two-pool cycle from not-profitable to profitable after the flash premium, DEX fee, and a gas cushion (max base fee of the window endpoints, plus the chain's L1/Timeboost dollar cushion). It is captured only if a later transaction in the same block or the next block touches both pools and the profit goes to zero or below. A spread that dies without such a two-pool transaction is ambiguous. A spread still profitable at the end of the next block is uncaptured and counted once. Edges above the suspect threshold are dropped. Dust TVL (either pool under the long-tail minimum) is not counted. This is not a live trading result.
